privileged_info_for_vlm: The DICOM data will likely belong to one of two patients: PatientID '556342B' (CT scan) or '322-292-73-6' (MR scan). The text file must follow the exact format: 'PatientID: [Value]', 'StudyUID: [Value]', and 'SeriesUID: [Value]'. The expected paths are /home/ga/DICOM/exports/routing_info.txt and /home/ga/DICOM/exports/dicom_info_screen.png.
